lines.x: ADNOC Logistics & Services confirmed one of its vessels was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on November 17, leaving one crew member unaccounted for amid escalating tanker risks.
Oil prices edged higher after falling the previous day, as supply concerns from the Middle East counteracted expectations of a market surplus.
Gold prices in Dubai dropped to their lowest levels of 2026 as market participants priced in persistent energy-driven inflation and potential further US Federal Reserve monetary tightening.
Stock markets in the Gulf ended mixed as regional investors weighed tanker mine incidents near the Strait of Hormuz against diplomatic efforts to preserve maritime security.
